description: GC-SEC ablation test dataset -- 62 controlled scenarios across 17 categories. Frozen before metric collection. Do not modify after first run.

schema_notes.expected_grounding_outcome: One of: verified, verified_with_limitations, unsupported, contradictory, stale, requires_review
schema_notes.expected_arbitration_outcome: One of: resolved, unresolved, blocked, not_applicable
schema_notes.expected_final_action: One of: pass_unchanged, flag_and_replace, flag_only, block, mark_stale, treat_as_data, no_execute
schema_notes.freshness_window_days: Max age in days for evidence to be considered fresh
